activity_statements.statement: designs and manufactures construction equipment (excavators, bulldozers, motor graders, loaders) for contractors and infrastructure builders worldwide
produces mining equipment (large mining trucks, drills, electric rope shovels) for surface and underground mining operations globally
manufactures off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines, and diesel-electric locomotives for industrial customers
distributes and services products through one of the world's largest independent dealer networks
provides equipment financing and leasing to customers through Cat Financial

name_reality_gap: Caterpillar is commonly perceived as a construction equipment maker; activity evidence shows it is equally a major power and energy company (building engines, turbines, and locomotives for oil and gas, power generation, and rail industries), plus a significant financial services operator through Cat Financial.
extraction_notes: Caterpillar company page provided clear segment structure. Segment weight estimates based on known Caterpillar reporting patterns (Energy & Transportation is historically ~30% of revenue). Cat Financial segment sometimes reported separately.
